description: Send a single prompt to any UnoRouter model and return the reply. Use search_models to find model IDs; :free models cost nothing (light per-model rate limit, rotate models if you hit 429).

max_tokens.description: Upper bound on reply length in tokens; the model default when omitted

model.description: Model id from search_models, e.g. deepseek-v4-flash:free

prompt.description: The user message to send to the model

system.description: Optional system prompt sent before the user message

temperature.description: Sampling temperature from 0 (deterministic) to 2 (most random); the model default when omitted

name: chat
title: Chat with a UnoRouter model
